name: Dulux Acrylic Putty
description: Dulux Acrylic Wall putty is formulated for filling cracks, joints, leveling uneven and rough masonry and plasterwork up to 3-4mm. It is also used for filling defective cement surfaces to give a smooth and excellent finish.

name: Dulux Aquatech Exterior Pre Treatment Coat
Dulux Aquatech Exterior PU Coat
description: Dulux Aquatech Exterior PU coat is a superior waterproofing technology with hybrid Acrylic-Polyurethane technology and is suitable for both horizontal and vertical wall application. Its thick, elastomeric super protective film covers cracks of upto 4mm and the strong network of reinforced polymers makes the coating extremely tough and dirt & water resistant.
features: Superior Waterproofing Performance of upto 15 years
Surface Temperature reduction of upto 12 deg C
coverage:
– upto 10 sqft/L for Horizontal Surfaces in 3 coats
– upto 40 sqft/L for Vertical Surfaces in 1 coat

name: Dulux Aquatech Interior & Exterior Crackfiller (5mm/10mm/20mm)
features: Shrinkfree- fills in just one application
Quick dry & tough- Accepts nails and screws in 4-6 hrs
coverage: 30-75 rft per Kg. (depending on Crack Filler Type)

name: Dulux Aquatech Interior Waterproof Basecoat
description: Dulux Aquatech Interior Waterproof basecoat is an easy to apply, primer-upgrade waterproofing undercoat that is made up of micronized pigments and fillers forming an extremely tough film that protects the top coat layer from mild dampness. It offers 10X better water resistance and 2X higher stretchability against ordinary primers, thus providing better finish and performance to topcoats.

name: Dulux Aquatech Waterblock 2K
description: Aquatech Waterblock 2k is a specialist 2 component product that provides protection against water penetration for interior walls, bathrooms and kitchens. Its unique Hydro breathe technology prevents swelling, blistering and chalking of paint. The breathable coating prevents the top paint layer from peeling off. The coating is suitable to be applied on the interior surface of swimming pools before applying tiling or topcoat. The product can be applied in water tanks as well.
features: Suitable for waterproofing of sunken areas

name: Dulux Aquatech Waterproof Putty
description: Dulux Aquatech Waterproof Putty is a premium quality powder putty that is specially designed with silicone and anti-efflorescence additives to give unique waterproofing properties and efflorescence resistance for a smooth finish and extended life to the top coats.

name: Dulux Aquatech Waterproof Repair Polymer
description: Dulux Aquatech Waterproof Repair Polymer (WRP) is a ready to use multipurpose latex-based bonding additive for use in mortars, bond coats, and waterproofing primers. It is used for repairing damaged concrete, columns, beams, and chajjas. It is also used for waterproofing of toilets, balconies, and sunken areas.

name: Dulux Promise Exterior Primer
description: Dulux Promise Exterior Primer is a good quality, water-based primer for external surfaces. Its unique Anti-Peel formulation ensures superior adhesion for the paint film, thereby resisting peeling or flaking of the topcoat.

name: Dulux Promise Interior Primer
description: Dulux Promise Interior Primer is a good quality primer having good adhesion to interior masonry surfaces, both new and previously decorated such as brickwork, plaster, cement, fibre boards, etc. It is specially formulated to give good filling property. Correct application of primer assures better quality and durability of the finished coat.

name: Dulux Quick Drying Primer
description: Dulux Quick Drying Primer is a premium quality water-based primer for application on wood and metal surfaces. It is ec0-friendly water-based undercoat with low odour and low voc. Unlike conventional solvent based primers it dries quickly and therefore the topcoat ca n be applied on the same day.

name: Dulux Red-oxide Metal Primer
description: This is a solvent based economical primer anti-corrosive protective primer for interior and exterior ferrous and non-ferrous metal work, including steel work, new, weathered and pre-treated zinc and galvanized iron. It may also be applied over pre-treated aluminium.

name: Dulux Water-based Cement Primer
description: Dulux Water Based Cement Primer is a water based primer, suitable for use on plastered masonry, POP, puttied, limed or pre-painted wall surfaces.

name: Dulux Zinc Yellow Metal Primer
description: Dulux Zinc Yellow Metal Primer is a solvent based protective primer suitable for interior and exterior ferrous and surface treated non-ferrous metal work. It gives effective protection against Corrosion to the surface and has strong adhesion properties. Appropriate application of the primer ensures better protection to the metal surface as well as higher durability of finish coat.

name: Velvet Touch Diamond Glo
description: Dulux Velvet Touch Diamond Glo is a super premium quality, highly durable and washable emulsion paint with a best in class high sheen luxury finish. It is the only super premium interior emulsion that brings alive the smooth touch of Velvet and glo of Diamonds on the walls. Uniquely formulated with Surface slip technology, Diamond Glo has the Best in Class Stain and Water Repellence- better than any other ordinary emulsion. Now with Tru Color (Dura Color Technology), Velvet Touch is made with the finest ingredients and color pigments to deliver intense rich colors and ultra-smooth finish on your walls.
